sloka: अद्य लोकास्त्रयः कृत्स्ना पृथिवी च सकानना।एकेनेन्द्रजिता हीना शून्येव प्रतिभाति मे ।। ६.९३.११ ।।
transliteration: adya lokāstrayaḥ kṛtsnā pṛthivī ca sakānanā।ekenendrajitā hīnā śūnyeva pratibhāti me ।। 6.93.11 ।।

translations.english: Today without Indrajith alone the three worlds (earth, heaven, and underworld) including forests are desolate, dark, and lustreless to me.
